# INSTALL THE R PACKAGE *healthiar*

We recommend to frequently install the newest *healthiar* version.

## Installation from CRAN:

Click on the *Packages* tab in RStudio and in *Install*. From CRAN,
search *healthiar* and click on *Install* keeping *Install dependencies*
activated.

## Installation from Github (most recent version):

Run the following commands below in RStudio to install *healthiar*:

1.  `install.packages(c("knitr", "rmarkdown"))`

2.  `remotes::install_github(repo = "SwissTPH/healthiar", build_vignettes = TRUE)`

3.  If you get asked to install or update any dependencies (= other
    packages that are needed for *healthiar*) please install or update
    all of them.

## Load the package

Do not forget to load the package after the installation entering in
your R console:
[`library(healthiar)`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/library.html).

## Requirement

R version 4.3.0 or higher

## Note

If you had previously installed *healthiar* while the repository was
still private, you must remove your personal access token (PAT) before
installing the package again.

# GET STARTED WITH *healthiar*

The vignette *intro_to_healthiar* (i.e. documentation on how to use the
healthiar package) will get you started with the *healthiar* R package.
You have the following options to find it:

1.  On the [Github
    page](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/articles/index.html)

2.  In R Studio: Click on the *Packages* tab in RStudio, scroll down to
    the *healthiar* package and clicking on the hyperlinks *healthiar*
    \> *User guides, package vignettes and other documentation*

3.  In the web browser: Run `browseVignettes("healthiar")` in the R
    console and the page will open up in your browser

A 45’ minutes introduction to the package can be found
[here](https://team.swisstph.ch/s/aN_wN5MUTAS3bwEkWvtvaQ)

The slides of the presentation can be found
[here](https://github.com/SwissTPH/healthiar/tree/master/varia/Workshops_and_demos/workshop)

# Package index

## All functions

- [`attribute_health()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/dev/reference/attribute_health.md)
  : Attribute health impacts to an environmental stressor
- [`attribute_lifetable()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/dev/reference/attribute_lifetable.md)
  : Attribute premature deaths or YLL to an environmental stressor using
  a life table approach
- [`attribute_mod()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/dev/reference/attribute_mod.md)
  : Create a scenario 2 by modifying an existing scenario 1 and
  determine attributable health impacts in it
- [`cba()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/dev/reference/cba.md) :
  Cost-benefit analysis
- [`compare()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/dev/reference/compare.md)
  : Compare the attributable health impacts between two scenarios
- [`daly()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/dev/reference/daly.md)
  : Attributable disability-adjusted life years
- [`discount()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/dev/reference/discount.md)
  : Discount health impacts
- [`get_discount_factor()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/dev/reference/get_discount_factor.md)
  : Get discount factor
- [`get_inflation_factor()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/dev/reference/get_inflation_factor.md)
  : Get inflation factor
- [`get_paf()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/dev/reference/get_paf.md)
  : Get population attributable fraction
- [`get_pif()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/dev/reference/get_pif.md)
  : Get population impact fraction
- [`get_risk()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/dev/reference/get_risk.md)
  : Get the relative risk of an exposure level
- [`monetize()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/dev/reference/monetize.md)
  : Monetize health impacts
- [`multiexpose()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/dev/reference/multiexpose.md)
  : Aggregate health impacts from multiple exposures
- [`prepare_exposure()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/dev/reference/prepare_exposure.md)
  : Prepare exposure data
- [`prepare_lifetable()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/dev/reference/prepare_lifetable.md)
  : Convert multi-year life table to single year life table
- [`prepare_mdi()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/dev/reference/prepare_mdi.md)
  : Create the BEST-COST Multidimensional Deprivation Index (MDI)
- [`socialize()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/dev/reference/socialize.md)
  : Consider socio-economic aspects in healthiar assessments
- [`standardize()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/dev/reference/standardize.md)
  : Obtain age-standardized health impacts
- [`summarize_uncertainty()`](https://swisstph.github.io/healthiar/dev/reference/summarize_uncertainty.md)
  : Get Monte Carlo confidence intervals
